name: Joi Dorei Byoutou
source:
Main character gets fraudulently fired from a major trading company. He catches some disease resembling a cold and is treated in the hospital by a doctor who used to be abused a lot at school. The medicine does not help, so the protagonist blackmails the doctor to reveal the fact that it was a misdiagnosis to ruin her reputation. This way he makes her his slave during the hospitalization period.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
